gold: Primary signet-ring cell carcinoma of the bladder

selector.rationale: The vignette describes a polypoidal mass arising from the bladder dome with histopathological analysis revealing an adenocarcinoma composed of mucinous and signet-ring cell components, which is best explained by Urinary Bladder Adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Primary adenocarcinoma of the bladder
rejected.why: less specific than Urinary Bladder Adenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Mucinous Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: less comprehensive than Urinary Bladder Adenocarcinoma given the presence of signet-ring cell components

rejected.label: Secondary adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: no clear evidence of metastasis from another primary site

rejected.label: Signet-Ring Cell Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: while present, not the most comprehensive diagnosis given the mucinous component
